question: How can even the element earth become a support for realizing Bhairava-hood?
premises: Even the earth can be seen without conceptualization.
It can be seen as reflected in one's own self.
The same method applies to water and the other elements.
inference: Non-conceptual recognition of any element as a reflection in the self leads to Bhairava-hood.
plain_english: Seeing even the earth itself, without conceptualization, as reflected in one's own self, one attains Bhairava-hood; the same method applies to water and the other elements as well.
